title: 食べないのは悪手だよ

text_block_list.text: On the way to lunch with Gold City, we meet Yukino Bijin in the hallway.
Grrrumble!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gosh, I'm starv'n…
choice_data_list: That was quite a stomach growl.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, haven't you had lunch?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, you see… The other day, I went to a sweets buffet with a friend…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: After we finished, my friend said she ate a bit too much, so she started this diet.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Then I noticed my skirt was feeling a little tight, so I figured I should join her… Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I see. But that doesn't mean you should skip meals.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: In fact, you came just at the right time, Yukino. Follow me!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So, are there any types of food you don't like?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Not particularly, but… um, City? This is the cafeteria…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: That's right. Trainer and I were just about to eat lunch, so you should join us too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: B-but…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Eat a balanced meal and you'll be fine. First up, you should include some fiber-rich vegetables…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, and soy products are good too. Do you like tofu and natto?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, I like 'em both!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, there's grilled fish on today's menu. Do you like fish?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I love fish!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But, um, do you really think I should be eating this?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It's fine. Oh, you should eat your vegetables first. It'll slow down the digestion and absorption process.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You know, skipping meals tends to backfire—you end up eating even more later to compensate for the lack of energy.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Plus, if you don't get enough nutrients, it's going to affect your skin too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Your skin is so beautiful and smooth, it would be a shame if you started breaking out. Got it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! I-I'll do m'best!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'm gonna eat well as I can!
I'm always impressed by the beauty perspective that Gold City brings.
Maybe she can help me out with some of my own beauty troubles…
choice_data_list: You know… I'm actually trying to build more muscle…
Do you know what I can eat to feel full?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? You care about that kind of thing too?
choice_data_list: Well, I want to look good for those interviews!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see. Let me think…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Okay—how's this for an idea? Just for today, I'll be your trainer and you can be the trainee.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Now give me ten more! Don't give up—you got this!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Strengthening the lats will improve your posture, which, of course, will make you look better in photos.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But you know all that already. You're a trainer after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Guess I can just watch, then.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …This is so weird. A trainer being trained by an Umamusume.
Over the following months, Gold City helps me stick to the regimen until I start to see results.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'd like to know that too!
choice_data_list: I tend to get kind of hungry really often…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well, my usual tactic is to snack on nuts if I get hungry…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But tell you what—I'll make a list to give both of you later. I got it from an experienced model when I was first starting out.
choice_data_list: A diet list for professional models?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoooa, but isn't that classified information?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It's not that special. You can find the information on the list just about anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Since I don't have the list to give you both now… well, I'll just have to pick your foods for you.
Thanks to the very satisfying menu she served me, I manage to get my afternoon's work done smoothly.
